description: Issue #2381: the single outcome catalog for job runs — success AND failure. The code NAME encodes the outcome (SUCCESS_* / FAILURE_*) plus its meaning, so a run's outcome is unmistakable from the name alone. businessMessage goes to UI and channels; technicalDetail goes to logs only. Success entries are new in #2381; failure entries are the #1252 error catalog renamed 1:1 (businessMessage, technicalDetail, category, retryable, httpStatus preserved verbatim). Stored rows are NEVER rewritten: pre-rename values resolve at read time through legacyAliases only. Issue #2608 adds the top-level runDetailMessages section: the 18 RUN_* Run Details messages (template with {param} placeholders, action, severity, level, params), resolved through the single resolver in outcomeAspects.ts — never a second catalog, and never outcome keys (RUN_* codes are display templates with parameters, not SUCCESS/FAILURE outcomes).

FAILURE_ALPACA_SIGNIN_REJECTED.businessMessage: Alpaca rejected that key pair for the selected trading type. Check that the key id and secret belong to the paper or live account shown, then try again.
FAILURE_ALPACA_SIGNIN_REJECTED.technicalDetail: Alpaca GET /v2/account answered 401/403 for the submitted pair against the selected trading type host; the upstream body is logged server-side only and never surfaced.

FAILURE_ALPACA_UPSTREAM.businessMessage: Alpaca did not respond to the connection check. Verify Alpaca API credentials are configured, then try again.
FAILURE_ALPACA_UPSTREAM.technicalDetail: Alpaca account/positions/orders read returned !success or threw; the raw provider message is logged server-side only, never surfaced.

FAILURE_ANNUAL_DISCOUNT_INVALID.businessMessage: The annual discount must be a number between 0 and 100.
FAILURE_ANNUAL_DISCOUNT_INVALID.technicalDetail: assertAnnualDiscountPct rejected a non-numeric, non-finite, or out-of-range discount value.

FAILURE_ANNUAL_PLAN_PERIOD_INVALID.businessMessage: A plan derived from a monthly plan must be an annual plan with a 365-day period.
FAILURE_ANNUAL_PLAN_PERIOD_INVALID.technicalDetail: POST /plans derivation refused: monthlyPlanId given without priceUSD and periodDays is not 365.

FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_CORRUPT.businessMessage: The stored approved-free quota count is invalid, so no runs were counted from it.
FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_CORRUPT.technicalDetail: Stored approved-free quota count row failed validation (non-integer or negative used) — fail-closed, nothing counted (#3263).

FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.businessMessage: You've used your approved-free runs for this service in the current period. Upgrade or buy credits to keep running screens.
FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.technicalDetail: Approved-free per-service quota exhausted for the family in the current period (#3263, #3241 decision 4): nothing runs over allowance.

FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED_ST.businessMessage: You've used your approved-free runs for this service in the current period. No further runs are available under this grant.
FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED_ST.technicalDetail: Approved-free per-service quota exhausted for the family in the current period and the operator set the stop action (#3263, #3241 decision 4): nothing runs over allowance.

FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_EXPIRED.businessMessage: Your approved-free grant has expired. Runs now follow the normal paid path.
FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_EXPIRED.technicalDetail: Approved-free grant inactive with an expiry set (#3263, #3245): the grant window has ended.

FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_INVALID_ACTI.businessMessage: The approved-free at-limit action must be upgrade-or-buy-credits or stop.
FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_INVALID_ACTI.technicalDetail: Operator set an at-limit action outside upgrade_or_buy_credits | stop (#3263).

FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_INVALID_CAP.businessMessage: The approved-free cap must be a non-negative whole number of runs.
FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_INVALID_CAP.technicalDetail: Operator set a cap that is not a non-negative integer (#3263).

FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_INVALID_FAMI.businessMessage: That product is not a valid approved-free quota service.
FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_INVALID_FAMI.technicalDetail: Family outside stock | goal | options | strategy (#3263).

FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_INVALID_SETT.businessMessage: The approved-free quota settings are incomplete.
FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_INVALID_SETT.technicalDetail: Approved-free quota settings require windowKind and atLimitAction when no settings row exists yet (#3263).

FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_INVALID_WIND.businessMessage: The approved-free quota window must be a month or a week.
FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_INVALID_WIND.technicalDetail: Operator set a window kind outside month | week (#3263).

FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_MISSING_UPDA.businessMessage: Provide a cap, a window, or an at-limit action to update the approved-free quota.
FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_MISSING_UPDA.technicalDetail: POST approved-free-quota carried none of {family, capRuns} | {windowKind} | {atLimitAction} (#3263).

FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_UNAVAILABLE.businessMessage: The approved-free quota store is unavailable right now.
FAILURE_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_UNAVAILABLE.technicalDetail: AGENT_DB unbound or the approved-free quota store could not be read (#3263).

FAILURE_ASYNC_JOB_FAILED.businessMessage: The background request could not be completed. Try again.
FAILURE_ASYNC_JOB_FAILED.technicalDetail: The async job the 202 receipt pointed at reached the failed terminal state; the job error is recorded server-side (async_job.failed) and never rendered to the client.

FAILURE_ASYNC_JOB_ORPHANED.businessMessage: The background job was orphaned when its host restarted; it never recorded a result. Try again.
FAILURE_ASYNC_JOB_ORPHANED.technicalDetail: Issue #4002: the async-job executor died with its host (a deploy restart) before a result was recorded. The last activity time is recorded server-side (async_job.failed) and never rendered to the client.

FAILURE_ASYNC_JOB_STILL_PROCESSING.businessMessage: Your request is still being processed. It will continue in the background — try again shortly.
FAILURE_ASYNC_JOB_STILL_PROCESSING.technicalDetail: apiFetch polled the async-job status URL until its deadline without a terminal state; the job continues server-side and the client surfaced the 408 rather than the raw poll state.

FAILURE_ASYNC_JOB_TIMEOUT.businessMessage: The background job exceeded its maximum runtime and was stopped. Try again.
FAILURE_ASYNC_JOB_TIMEOUT.technicalDetail: Issue #3907: the async-job executor's max-runtime deadline fired while the capability leg was still running; the job was failed with this code (never silently reaped as unknown-outcome). The hung leg was abandoned, not aborted — its late result, if any, is dropped because the row is already terminal.

FAILURE_AUTH_NO_SESSION.businessMessage: No E*TRADE session is stored for this account. Please connect your account in Settings.
FAILURE_AUTH_NO_SESSION.technicalDetail: No E*TRADE OAuth token set exists in the SessionStore for the user in the resolved environment

FAILURE_AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED.businessMessage: E*TRADE connection expired. Please reconnect your account in Settings.
FAILURE_AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED.technicalDetail: E*TRADE OAuth access token is missing in PROD mode

FAILURE_AUTH_TOKEN_MISSING.businessMessage: Authentication required. Please reconnect your brokerage account.

FAILURE_BROKER_UNAVAILABLE.businessMessage: This broker surface is not available for the selected broker. Change the broker selection in Settings.
FAILURE_BROKER_UNAVAILABLE.technicalDetail: Broker surface requested for a tenant whose selected broker has no implementation for it; no fallback broker was used.

FAILURE_CHANNEL_FORBIDDEN.businessMessage: Only the channel purchase owner may confirm it.
FAILURE_CHANNEL_FORBIDDEN.technicalDetail: Channel confirm attempted by a login other than the draft owner.

FAILURE_CHANNEL_FULFIL_FAILED.businessMessage: Payment is verified, but the fulfilment could not be recorded with cfpay. No credit has been granted; an operator must reconcile.
FAILURE_CHANNEL_FULFIL_FAILED.technicalDetail: checkout.fulfil returned ok=false or threw after a paid checkout.status retrieve; draft stays minted.

FAILURE_CHANNEL_NOT_CONFIGURED.businessMessage: The cfpay channel is not configured. An operator must set the channel fixed price before channel purchases are offered.
FAILURE_CHANNEL_NOT_CONFIGURED.technicalDetail: No approved catalogue price for the family, or the operator channel fixed price is unset.

FAILURE_CHANNEL_NOT_PAID.businessMessage: The cfpay checkout is not paid for this purchase. No credit has been granted.
FAILURE_CHANNEL_NOT_PAID.technicalDetail: checkout.status retrieve did not show a paid-allowlist status, or the retrieved requestId/email did not match the draft.

FAILURE_CHANNEL_PRICE_MISMATCH.businessMessage: This offer cannot be sold through the cfpay channel: its price does not match the channel's configured fixed price.
FAILURE_CHANNEL_PRICE_MISMATCH.technicalDetail: Approved catalogue price differs from the operator-attested channel fixed price; the card takes no amount input.

FAILURE_CHANNEL_REPLAY.businessMessage: This cfpay channel purchase is already fulfilled.
FAILURE_CHANNEL_REPLAY.technicalDetail: Confirm attempted on a draft whose status is already fulfilled.

FAILURE_CHANNEL_UNAVAILABLE.businessMessage: The cfpay channel could not be reached. No credit has been granted.
FAILURE_CHANNEL_UNAVAILABLE.technicalDetail: cfpay A2A call returned ok=false or threw during mint, status retrieve, or totals.

FAILURE_CHANNEL_UNKNOWN_PURCHASE.technicalDetail: No channel draft row exists for the supplied channel request id.

FAILURE_CHECKOUT_PORT_BREAKER_OPEN.businessMessage: The payment service is temporarily unavailable. Nothing was charged or credited. Try again shortly.
FAILURE_CHECKOUT_PORT_BREAKER_OPEN.technicalDetail: Checkout-port circuit breaker open for the rail; call rejected without a provider call (fail-fast); no credit was granted.

FAILURE_CHECKOUT_PORT_TIMEOUT.businessMessage: The payment service took too long to respond. Nothing was charged or credited. Try again.
FAILURE_CHECKOUT_PORT_TIMEOUT.technicalDetail: Checkout-port call exceeded the configured timeout; outcome unknown — the confirm re-reads provider state on retry; no credit was granted on this attempt.

FAILURE_DATA_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.businessMessage: A market-data provider was unavailable; results may be partial.
FAILURE_DATA_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.technicalDetail: Provider fetch failed after policy retries (e.g. Yahoo throttling/unreachable); symbols dropped as provider-unavailable

FAILURE_DELIVERY_CHANNEL_FAILED.businessMessage: Report delivery failed on this channel.
FAILURE_DELIVERY_CHANNEL_FAILED.technicalDetail: Delivery port returned ok=false or threw; see the transport detail

FAILURE_DELIVERY_RECIPIENT_NOT_ALLOWED.businessMessage: The delivery recipient is not on the screener email allowlist; delivery refused.
FAILURE_DELIVERY_RECIPIENT_NOT_ALLOWED.technicalDetail: Effective recipient failed isEmailAllowed against SCREENER_EMAIL_ALLOWLIST / run-owner rule

FAILURE_ETRADE_ACCOUNTS_UNAVAILABLE.businessMessage: Broker accounts are temporarily unavailable. Please try again, and reconnect your E*TRADE account if the problem persists.
FAILURE_ETRADE_ACCOUNTS_UNAVAILABLE.technicalDetail: E*TRADE accounts read returned an empty result with a recorded upstream error; the raw upstream body is logged by ETradeRestClient and never surfaced.

FAILURE_ETRADE_ALERTS_UNAVAILABLE.businessMessage: Broker alerts are temporarily unavailable. Please try again, and reconnect your E*TRADE account if the problem persists.
FAILURE_ETRADE_ALERTS_UNAVAILABLE.technicalDetail: E*TRADE alerts read returned an empty result with a recorded upstream error; the raw upstream body is logged by ETradeRestClient and never surfaced.

FAILURE_ETRADE_OAUTH_EXCHANGE_FAILED.businessMessage: E*TRADE rejected the verification code. Authorize once in a fresh tab and submit that code promptly; a code from an earlier attempt cannot be reused.
FAILURE_ETRADE_OAUTH_EXCHANGE_FAILED.technicalDetail: E*TRADE /oauth/access_token returned non-OK (e.g. 401 on a spent or mismatched verifier); the raw upstream body is logged server-side only, never surfaced.

FAILURE_ETRADE_OAUTH_RENEW_FAILED.businessMessage: E*TRADE rejected the renewal request. Try again, or reconnect E*TRADE if the problem persists.
FAILURE_ETRADE_OAUTH_RENEW_FAILED.technicalDetail: E*TRADE /oauth/renew_access_token returned null (upstream rejection) after a stored token was present and unexpired.

FAILURE_ETRADE_OAUTH_REQUEST_TOKEN_FAILE.businessMessage: E*TRADE rejected the authorization request. If your key is a sandbox key, switch to TEST; live production needs an approved production key. Then connect again.
FAILURE_ETRADE_OAUTH_REQUEST_TOKEN_FAILE.technicalDetail: E*TRADE /oauth/request_token returned non-OK; the raw upstream body is logged server-side only, never surfaced.

FAILURE_ETRADE_OAUTH_START_FAILED.businessMessage: E*TRADE authorization could not be started. Close any E*TRADE tab, then connect once and authorize in the fresh tab.
FAILURE_ETRADE_OAUTH_START_FAILED.technicalDetail: E*TRADE OAuth start call failed before an authorize URL was issued (network, timeout, or non-OK start response); the pre-opened tab is reclaimed to the app with this outcome code.

FAILURE_ETRADE_ORDERS_UNAVAILABLE.businessMessage: Broker orders are temporarily unavailable. Please try again, and reconnect your E*TRADE account if the problem persists.
FAILURE_ETRADE_ORDERS_UNAVAILABLE.technicalDetail: E*TRADE orders read returned an empty result with a recorded upstream error; the raw upstream body is logged by ETradeRestClient and never surfaced.

FAILURE_ETRADE_TRANSACTIONS_UNAVAILABLE.businessMessage: Broker transactions are temporarily unavailable. Please try again, and reconnect your E*TRADE account if the problem persists.
FAILURE_ETRADE_TRANSACTIONS_UNAVAILABLE.technicalDetail: E*TRADE transactions read returned an empty result with a recorded upstream error; the raw upstream body is logged by ETradeRestClient and never surfaced.

FAILURE_ETRADE_UPSTREAM.businessMessage: Broker data is temporarily unavailable. Please try again, and reconnect your E*TRADE account if the problem persists.
FAILURE_ETRADE_UPSTREAM.technicalDetail: E*TRADE upstream read failed with a recorded error; the raw upstream body is logged by ETradeRestClient and never surfaced.

FAILURE_ETRADE_WATCHLISTS_UNAVAILABLE.businessMessage: Broker watchlists are temporarily unavailable. Please try again, and reconnect your E*TRADE account if the problem persists.
FAILURE_ETRADE_WATCHLISTS_UNAVAILABLE.technicalDetail: E*TRADE watchlists read returned an empty result with a recorded upstream error; the raw upstream body is logged by ETradeRestClient and never surfaced.

FAILURE_MCP_PERMISSION_DENIED.businessMessage: This tool is not available for your current access level.
FAILURE_MCP_PERMISSION_DENIED.technicalDetail: MCP tool permission scope not held by caller principal

FAILURE_OFFER_COVERAGE_EXISTS.businessMessage: The account has coverage for the next run, so no offer applies.
FAILURE_OFFER_COVERAGE_EXISTS.technicalDetail: Offer derivation (#3246) found coverage for the next run (grant within quota, free allowance, included runs, or credits at or above the approved price); the payload is ineligible with this reason, never rendered as a user-facing accusation.

FAILURE_OFFER_DISABLED.businessMessage: Upgrade offers are disabled by the operator.
FAILURE_OFFER_DISABLED.technicalDetail: Offer derivation (#3246) refused: the monetization flag is OFF, the offer-rules master switch is off, or the trigger is disabled in the operator rules. Payload reason, HTTP 200: disabled is a state, not an error.

FAILURE_OFFER_DISMISS_INVALID.businessMessage: The dismissal request was invalid: the trigger is unknown or cannot be dismissed.
FAILURE_OFFER_DISMISS_INVALID.technicalDetail: POST /commercial/offer/dismiss (#3246) rejected the body: unknown trigger, or the ambient trigger, which is never dismissible.

FAILURE_OFFER_NO_TARGET.businessMessage: No higher plan is available for this account and segment.
FAILURE_OFFER_NO_TARGET.technicalDetail: Offer derivation (#3246) found no purchasable action: no effective approved higher version for the segment, no top-up path, and no runs-pack version (slice 3). Payload reason, HTTP 200.

FAILURE_OFFER_RULES_INVALID.technicalDetail: assertOfferRules (#3246) rejected the offer_rules block: a missing or non-boolean field, a cooldown outside 1..365 whole days, or an unknown key. The stored rules are unchanged.

FAILURE_OFFER_SUPPRESSED.businessMessage: This offer was dismissed and the cooldown has not expired.
FAILURE_OFFER_SUPPRESSED.technicalDetail: Offer derivation (#3246) found a live suppression row for (login, trigger) (#3246 section 4.4). Payload reason, HTTP 200; the client shows the fixed at-limit copy with no offer section.

FAILURE_OFFER_UNAVAILABLE.businessMessage: The upgrade offer could not be computed right now. Please try again.
FAILURE_OFFER_UNAVAILABLE.technicalDetail: An offer store (account, plans, products, policy, or suppressions) is unbound or unavailable (#3246). The client falls back to the existing fixed at-limit copy.

FAILURE_PLAN_APPROVAL_INVALID.businessMessage: An approval must name its approver.
FAILURE_PLAN_APPROVAL_INVALID.technicalDetail: assertApproverId rejected a blank or non-string approver id.

FAILURE_PLAN_NOT_FOUND.businessMessage: No plan with that id exists.
FAILURE_PLAN_NOT_FOUND.technicalDetail: Plan lookup by id returned no row.

FAILURE_PLAN_PRICE_NOT_APPROVED.businessMessage: This plan's price has not been approved yet. An operator must approve it before it can be charged.
FAILURE_PLAN_PRICE_NOT_APPROVED.technicalDetail: Charging path refused a plan with approvalStatus proposed before any provider call; no charge attempted.

FAILURE_PRODUCT_RANK_INVALID.businessMessage: The product rank is invalid, or this product's rank cannot be changed.
FAILURE_PRODUCT_RANK_INVALID.technicalDetail: The set-rank route (#3246) rejected the request: the rank failed validation (a positive whole number or null is required), or the product is prod-free, whose rank 1 is the definitional ladder floor (409).

FAILURE_PROFILE_DUPLICATE.businessMessage: This profile save was already received. The earlier save stands.
FAILURE_PROFILE_DUPLICATE.technicalDetail: Idempotency key already recorded for this profile; replay refused with 409 (Idempotent Receiver, standards §7.2).

FAILURE_PROFILE_NOT_SIGNED_IN.businessMessage: Sign in to view or change your profile.
FAILURE_PROFILE_NOT_SIGNED_IN.technicalDetail: No verified login in the session for the profile routes. Distinct from FAILURE_AUTH_NO_SESSION, which is E*TRADE-specific.

FAILURE_PROFILE_STORE_UNAVAILABLE.businessMessage: Your profile is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
FAILURE_PROFILE_STORE_UNAVAILABLE.technicalDetail: Profile store unbound or the store call threw; the routes fail closed, never a default profile.

FAILURE_PROFILE_VALIDATION.businessMessage: Some profile values are invalid. Check the form and try again.
FAILURE_PROFILE_VALIDATION.technicalDetail: displayName, phone, or idempotencyKey failed structural validation; the failing field is in the response body and the failure kind in logs only, never values.

FAILURE_PROMOTIONS_ACTIVE_CHECK_QUERY.businessMessage: The promotions live-check could not be read. Try again.
FAILURE_PROMOTIONS_ACTIVE_CHECK_QUERY.technicalDetail: SELECT-only read of the Orchestrator DO mas_promotions table failed inside the #1257 active-check route; the raw store error is not sent to the client

FAILURE_PUBLIC_NO_PAPER_MODE.businessMessage: Public.com has no paper trading mode, so this order cannot be placed while the trading mode is paper. Switch to live mode to place it, or use preview to check it first.
FAILURE_PUBLIC_NO_PAPER_MODE.technicalDetail: Issue #3990: Public.com offers no paper/sandbox trading; placement in TEST mode is refused at the platform seam before any broker call. Reads and preflight work in TEST.

FAILURE_QUOTE_AUTH_MISSING.businessMessage: Unable to retrieve live quotes. The screener will use the most recent available data.
FAILURE_QUOTE_AUTH_MISSING.technicalDetail: E*TRADE OAuth access token missing or expired

FAILURE_QUOTE_DATA_STALE.businessMessage: Market data delayed. Prices may not reflect current market.
FAILURE_QUOTE_DATA_STALE.technicalDetail: Quote returned zero/negative price (market closed or stale)

FAILURE_QUOTE_FORMAT_UNEXPECTED.businessMessage: Quote data format unexpected. Using cached data where available.
FAILURE_QUOTE_FORMAT_UNEXPECTED.technicalDetail: E*TRADE response JSON parse failed or unexpected structure

FAILURE_QUOTE_PARTIAL_SYMBOLS.businessMessage: Some symbols could not be quoted. Results show available data.
FAILURE_QUOTE_PARTIAL_SYMBOLS.technicalDetail: E*TRADE returned empty response for batch

FAILURE_QUOTE_RATE_LIMITED.businessMessage: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.

FAILURE_REPORT_ARTIFACT_MISSING.businessMessage: The generated report file could not be found for delivery.
FAILURE_REPORT_ARTIFACT_MISSING.technicalDetail: Follow-up report job found no adoptable artifact for the run's recorded keys

FAILURE_REPORT_CSV_GENERATION.businessMessage: The CSV report could not be generated.
FAILURE_REPORT_CSV_GENERATION.technicalDetail: Report pipeline CSV generation failed; csvError recorded on the run

FAILURE_REPORT_PDF_GENERATION.businessMessage: The PDF report could not be generated.
FAILURE_REPORT_PDF_GENERATION.technicalDetail: Report pipeline PDF render failed; pdfError recorded on the run

FAILURE_REPORT_XLSX_GENERATION.businessMessage: The XLSX report could not be generated.
FAILURE_REPORT_XLSX_GENERATION.technicalDetail: Report pipeline XLSX generation failed; xlsxError recorded on the run

FAILURE_RUNS_PACK_NOT_PAID.businessMessage: That runs-pack payment could not be verified yet. Complete the payment, then try again.
FAILURE_RUNS_PACK_NOT_PAID.technicalDetail: Pack confirm refused: the provider evidence did not verify for the draft's bound price (card session incomplete/unpaid/amount mismatch, or x402 proof unverified/payer or nonce mismatch) (#3246 slice 3).

FAILURE_RUNS_PACK_NO_APPROVED_PRICE.businessMessage: This runs pack's price is not approved yet, so it can't be bought.
FAILURE_RUNS_PACK_NO_APPROVED_PRICE.technicalDetail: Pack checkout mint refused: the named pack version's approvalStatus is not approved. Only an operator approval makes a pack version buyable (#3246 slice 3).

FAILURE_RUNS_PACK_REPLAY.businessMessage: This runs pack was already credited. No additional runs were added.
FAILURE_RUNS_PACK_REPLAY.technicalDetail: Confirm attempted on a pack draft whose status is already credited (idempotent replay returns the same success instead) or crediting (a concurrent confirm is in flight).

FAILURE_RUNS_PACK_UNAVAILABLE.businessMessage: Runs packs are unavailable right now. Try again later.
FAILURE_RUNS_PACK_UNAVAILABLE.technicalDetail: Runs-pack store or checkout ports unavailable at mint or confirm (#3246 slice 3).

FAILURE_SAGA_FAILED.businessMessage: The saga failed unexpectedly; the failure is recorded with its step and reason — start a fresh saga.
FAILURE_SAGA_FAILED.technicalDetail: Uncaught leg error caught by the #2810 catch-all: terminal saga.failed row (leg + reason) + outcome notice + saga.ended; the workflow completes with the failure outcome instead of erroring silently.

FAILURE_SAGA_JOURNEY_DENIED.businessMessage: The journey gate was denied; the saga ends with no trades and no proposals.
FAILURE_SAGA_JOURNEY_DENIED.technicalDetail: Saga journey gate denied by the instance owner; screen was delivered, no credit by default.

FAILURE_SAGA_JOURNEY_EXPIRED.businessMessage: The journey gate expired unanswered; the saga ends with no trades and no proposals.
FAILURE_SAGA_JOURNEY_EXPIRED.technicalDetail: Saga journey gate wait (24h working default) expired without an owner decision.

FAILURE_SAGA_PAYMENT_NOT_COMPLETED.businessMessage: Payment was not completed, so no screen ran and no trading leg started.
FAILURE_SAGA_PAYMENT_NOT_COMPLETED.technicalDetail: Saga Leg 0 ended without a started payment (payment_required, coverage_required, approval_rejected, expired, leg error, deadline, or unrecognized payment output).

FAILURE_SAGA_PROPOSAL_FAILED.businessMessage: The trade proposal failed; no approval workflow started and no order was placed.
FAILURE_SAGA_PROPOSAL_FAILED.technicalDetail: Preview-surface proposal refused (or no trade intent); no TradingTradeWorkflow child started, no credit by default (S4).

FAILURE_SAGA_SCREEN_FAILED.businessMessage: The paid screen failed after starting.
FAILURE_SAGA_SCREEN_FAILED.technicalDetail: Saga Leg 1 observed a terminal screen failure (Failed collation lifecycle, errored/terminated instance, deadline, or unrecognized output). S1 recorded the failure without issuing credit; S3 compensates under FAILURE_SAGA_SCREEN_FAILED_CREDIT_ISSUED / FAILURE_SAGA_SCREEN_FAILED_REFUND_REQUESTED. The code stays valid for stored S1-era rows.

FAILURE_SAGA_SCREEN_FAILED_CREDIT_ISSUED.businessMessage: The paid screen failed after starting; a one-time replacement-run credit was issued.
FAILURE_SAGA_SCREEN_FAILED_CREDIT_ISSUED.technicalDetail: Saga Leg 1 observed a terminal screen failure after start; the saga issued the one-time replacement-run credit (DO ledger row deduped per run + D1 claim) under the S3 rail-aware compensation step (x402, covered runs, unknown rail, or stripe refund unavailable).

FAILURE_SAGA_SCREEN_FAILED_REFUND_REQUES.businessMessage: The paid screen failed after starting; a provider refund was requested (operator approval required before money moves).
FAILURE_SAGA_SCREEN_FAILED_REFUND_REQUES.technicalDetail: Saga Leg 1 observed a terminal screen failure after start on a stripe-checkout run; the saga created a policy-gated pay-per-run refund request via RefundPorts (status requested; execution awaits operator approval through the existing operator route). One compensation per run: no credit is issued for this run.

FAILURE_SAGA_SCREEN_START_FAILED_CREDIT_.businessMessage: The paid screen failed to start; a one-time replacement-run credit was issued by the payment leg.
FAILURE_SAGA_SCREEN_START_FAILED_CREDIT_.technicalDetail: Saga Leg 0 observed the payment leg's screener_failed_credit_issued outcome; the saga recorded it and did not re-issue.

FAILURE_SAGA_TRADE_EXPIRED.businessMessage: The per-order approval wait expired; the saga ends with no order placed.
FAILURE_SAGA_TRADE_EXPIRED.technicalDetail: TradingTradeWorkflow child expired without a per-order decision in 24h; nothing settled (S4).

FAILURE_SAGA_TRADE_LEG_FAILED.businessMessage: The trading leg failed; the saga ends with the failure surfaced and no compensation.
FAILURE_SAGA_TRADE_LEG_FAILED.technicalDetail: Trade child errored, terminated, deadline, or unrecognized output; execution failure gets no compensation by design §3.3 (S4).

FAILURE_SAGA_TRADE_REJECTED.businessMessage: The trade was rejected at per-order approval; the saga ends with no order placed.
FAILURE_SAGA_TRADE_REJECTED.technicalDetail: TradingTradeWorkflow child settled with a rejected per-order decision; a user decision, not an error (S4).

FAILURE_SCREEN_NO_CONTRACTS_EVALUATED.businessMessage: The options screen was discarded — no contracts could be evaluated.
FAILURE_SCREEN_NO_CONTRACTS_EVALUATED.technicalDetail: Options scan evaluated zero contracts (chain fetch or coverage failure); run discarded by the coverage gate

FAILURE_SCREEN_PARTIAL_COVERAGE.businessMessage: The screen published qualified partial results — some symbols could not be evaluated.
FAILURE_SCREEN_PARTIAL_COVERAGE.technicalDetail: Partial coverage: a subset of the universe evaluated; failure reasons recorded on the run

FAILURE_SCREEN_RUN_FAILED.technicalDetail: Screener run completed with success=false; see the run error detail

FAILURE_SOCIAL_REWARD_CAP_REACHED.businessMessage: You've used this reward as much as allowed for now — try again after the daily or monthly window resets.
FAILURE_SOCIAL_REWARD_CAP_REACHED.technicalDetail: Social reward daily or monthly cap reached for the user and type.

FAILURE_SOCIAL_REWARD_EXPIRED.businessMessage: This reward has expired and can't be used.
FAILURE_SOCIAL_REWARD_EXPIRED.technicalDetail: Social reward grant was past expiresAtMs at redeem time.

FAILURE_SOCIAL_REWARD_NOT_CONFIGURED.businessMessage: Social rewards aren't set up yet, so this reward can't be granted right now.
FAILURE_SOCIAL_REWARD_NOT_CONFIGURED.technicalDetail: Social reward type is unconfigured (a required config value is null) or disabled; operator configuration is required.

FAILURE_SOCIAL_REWARD_NOT_VERIFIED.businessMessage: This social action hasn't been verified yet, so no reward can be granted for it.
FAILURE_SOCIAL_REWARD_NOT_VERIFIED.technicalDetail: Social reward grant refused: the like/share/subscribe action has no verification record.

FAILURE_SOCIAL_REWARD_NOT_VESTED.businessMessage: This reward isn't ready to use yet — it becomes usable after its vesting period.
FAILURE_SOCIAL_REWARD_NOT_VESTED.technicalDetail: Social reward grant was before vestedAtMs at redeem time.

FAILURE_STORE_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.businessMessage: The session store is temporarily at its provider limit. Please wait a moment and try again — your sign-in will be retried automatically.
FAILURE_STORE_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.technicalDetail: SessionStore (Durable Objects) or D1 provider limit exhausted — rows-read/written cap or rate limit; see #1819. Business message only to clients; provider wording never surfaced.

FAILURE_SUBSCRIPTION_CANCEL_FAILED.businessMessage: Canceling subscriptions failed partway. Check which subscriptions are still active before trying again.
FAILURE_SUBSCRIPTION_CANCEL_FAILED.technicalDetail: Provider cancel threw; rows canceled before the failure are listed in the response and audit; raw provider text is server-side only, never in the response.

FAILURE_SUBSCRIPTION_CANCEL_NONE_ACTIVE.businessMessage: No active subscription was found to cancel.
FAILURE_SUBSCRIPTION_CANCEL_NONE_ACTIVE.technicalDetail: Cancel found no unexpired in-scope subscriptions for the server-resolved (user, tenant); replay or already-canceled. No state changed.

FAILURE_SUBSCRIPTION_CANCEL_NOT_CONFIGUR.businessMessage: Billing cancel is not configured. No subscriptions were canceled.
FAILURE_SUBSCRIPTION_CANCEL_NOT_CONFIGUR.technicalDetail: No Billing port could be created (Stripe not configured); the cancel was refused before any provider or local write.

FAILURE_TOP_UP_AMOUNT_INVALID.businessMessage: The top-up amount is outside the allowed range. Check the amount and try again.
FAILURE_TOP_UP_AMOUNT_INVALID.technicalDetail: Mint amount failed validation: non-finite, non-positive, more than two decimals, or outside the operator-set billing-policy bounds.

FAILURE_TOP_UP_CHECKOUT_UNAVAILABLE.businessMessage: The top-up payment service is temporarily unavailable. No credit was added. Try again later.
FAILURE_TOP_UP_CHECKOUT_UNAVAILABLE.technicalDetail: No checkout port for the requested rail (card/x402 unconfigured), or the payment verification call failed.

FAILURE_TOP_UP_NOT_PAID.businessMessage: The top-up checkout is not paid yet. No credit was added. Complete the payment, then try again.
FAILURE_TOP_UP_NOT_PAID.technicalDetail: Top-up confirm retrieve/verdict did not show a paid checkout for the draft amount and reference; draft stays minted.

FAILURE_TOP_UP_RECONCILE_REQUIRED.businessMessage: The top-up could not be completed and needs operator review. No additional credit was added. Try again later or contact support.
FAILURE_TOP_UP_RECONCILE_REQUIRED.technicalDetail: Top-up credit failed after the draft was claimed and the claim could not be released; the draft is left crediting for operator reconcile.

FAILURE_TOP_UP_REPLAY.businessMessage: This top-up was already credited. No additional credit was added.
FAILURE_TOP_UP_REPLAY.technicalDetail: Confirm attempted on a draft whose status is already credited.

FAILURE_UNEXPECTED_ERROR.businessMessage: An unexpected error occurred. Our team has been notified.

FAILURE_USAGE_BILLING_INVALID_LIMIT.businessMessage: The requested result limit is invalid. Use a positive number up to 100.
FAILURE_USAGE_BILLING_INVALID_LIMIT.technicalDetail: limit query param was missing, non-integer, or less than 1; the reader mirrors the receipts bound (default 50, cap 100).

FAILURE_USAGE_BILLING_NOT_SIGNED_IN.businessMessage: Sign in to view your usage and billing.
FAILURE_USAGE_BILLING_NOT_SIGNED_IN.technicalDetail: No verified login in the session for the usage/billing reader. Self-only route; no identity is ever asserted.

FAILURE_USAGE_BILLING_STORE_UNAVAILABLE.businessMessage: Your usage and billing are temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
FAILURE_USAGE_BILLING_STORE_UNAVAILABLE.technicalDetail: A required store or port (commercial, subscription, refund, lifecycle, or the receipts seam) is unbound or threw; the reader fails closed, never a default view.

FAILURE_WATCHLIST_UNAVAILABLE.businessMessage: Watchlist is not available. Your portfolio data is shown below.

SUCCESS_ANNUAL_DISCOUNT_UPDATED.businessMessage: Annual discount updated. New annual plans derive their price from the new discount.
SUCCESS_ANNUAL_DISCOUNT_UPDATED.technicalDetail: POST billing-policy set annualDiscountPct; subsequent POST /plans derivations use the new value.

SUCCESS_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_COVERED.businessMessage: Your approved-free quota covered this run.
SUCCESS_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_COVERED.technicalDetail: Approved-free per-service quota covered the run within the cap (#3263): no charge, no deduction.

SUCCESS_APPROVED_FREE_QUOTA_UPDATED.technicalDetail: Approved-free quota cap or settings updated by a store operator (#3263).

SUCCESS_CHANNEL_PURCHASE_FULFILLED.businessMessage: cfpay channel purchase fulfilled: run credit added.
SUCCESS_CHANNEL_PURCHASE_FULFILLED.technicalDetail: checkout.status retrieve verified paid; commercial credits topped up by the bound catalogue price.

SUCCESS_JOB_COMPLETED.technicalDetail: Job run completed without a leg-specific outcome

SUCCESS_OFFER_DISMISSED.technicalDetail: POST /commercial/offer/dismiss (#3246) wrote the suppression row after auditing commercial.offer.dismissed.

SUCCESS_OFFER_RESOLVED.technicalDetail: Offer derivation (#3246) completed. Informational: the payload itself carries eligibility and targets; this code is never rendered as a banner.

SUCCESS_OFFER_RULES_UPDATED.technicalDetail: POST billing-policy (#3246) stored a new offer_rules block; subsequent derivations use the new rules.

SUCCESS_PLAN_APPROVED.businessMessage: Plan price approved. The plan can now be charged.
SUCCESS_PLAN_APPROVED.technicalDetail: POST /plans/approve set approvalStatus approved with approvedBy/approvedAtMs recorded.

SUCCESS_PLAN_CREATED.businessMessage: Plan created as proposed. An operator must approve its price before it can be charged.
SUCCESS_PLAN_CREATED.technicalDetail: POST /plans created a plan row with approvalStatus proposed; charging paths refuse it until POST /plans/approve.

SUCCESS_PRODUCT_RANK_UPDATED.technicalDetail: The set-rank route (#3246) stored the new rank; subsequent ladder derivations use it.

SUCCESS_PROFILE_READ.technicalDetail: Profile read returned the caller's own row (or nulls when no profile was ever set).

SUCCESS_PROFILE_UPDATED.technicalDetail: Profile upsert landed for the session-resolved login; audit platform.profile.updated carries the code.

SUCCESS_REPORT_DELIVERED.technicalDetail: Delivery port returned ok=true for the report

SUCCESS_RUNS_PACK_PURCHASED.businessMessage: The runs pack was purchased and its runs were added to your pack balance.
SUCCESS_RUNS_PACK_PURCHASED.technicalDetail: Pack confirm (#3246 slice 3) completed: verified payment, balance credited, journal Dr 1000 / Cr 4000 posted.

SUCCESS_SAGA_JOURNEY_APPROVED.businessMessage: The journey gate was approved; the saga will enter the trading leg.
SUCCESS_SAGA_JOURNEY_APPROVED.technicalDetail: Saga journey gate approved by the instance owner; the trading leg runs in S4 (sagaTradeLeg.ts: propose via the preview surfaces + TradingTradeWorkflow child).

SUCCESS_SAGA_SCREEN_COMPLETED.technicalDetail: Saga Leg 1 observed the screener child at terminal Completed or ReportGenerated collation lifecycle. S1 ends here; S2 adds the journey gate after this point.

SUCCESS_SAGA_TRADE_SETTLED.businessMessage: The trade leg settled; the saga ends with the trade outcome.
SUCCESS_SAGA_TRADE_SETTLED.technicalDetail: TradingTradeWorkflow child settled with an approved per-order decision; the saga ends at the trade outcome (S4).

SUCCESS_SCREEN_COMPLETED.technicalDetail: Screener run completed with full coverage

SUCCESS_SCREEN_PARTIAL_RESULTS.businessMessage: Screen completed with partial results — some symbols could not be evaluated.
SUCCESS_SCREEN_PARTIAL_RESULTS.technicalDetail: Screen completed with partial coverage; failure reasons recorded on the run

SUCCESS_SOCIAL_REWARD_GRANTED.businessMessage: Your social reward was granted. It becomes usable after its vesting period — check your rewards before it expires.
SUCCESS_SOCIAL_REWARD_GRANTED.technicalDetail: Social reward grant recorded; grant id, type, action, platform, vestedAtMs, and expiresAtMs are in the audit record.

SUCCESS_SOCIAL_REWARD_REDEEMED.technicalDetail: Social reward redemption applied; grant id, redeemed amount/units, and the run or subscription reference are in the audit record.

SUCCESS_SUBSCRIPTION_CANCELED_IMMEDIATE.businessMessage: Canceled immediately. Your access ended now. No cash refund is issued.
SUCCESS_SUBSCRIPTION_CANCELED_IMMEDIATE.technicalDetail: Immediate cancel: provider subscription deleted and the local row truncated to the cancel instant; accessThroughMs is the cancel instant.

SUCCESS_SUBSCRIPTION_CANCELED_PERIOD_END.businessMessage: Canceled. Your access continues through the end of the current period. No cash refund is issued.
SUCCESS_SUBSCRIPTION_CANCELED_PERIOD_END.technicalDetail: Cancel applied at period end: provider cancel_at_period_end confirmed and the local row marked canceled; accessThroughMs is the verified period end.

SUCCESS_TOP_UP_CREDITED.businessMessage: Top-up complete — the amount was added to your account balance.
SUCCESS_TOP_UP_CREDITED.technicalDetail: Top-up confirm verified payment against the minted draft and credited the commercial account via adjustCredits; draft marked credited.

SUCCESS_USAGE_BILLING_READ.businessMessage: Your usage and billing were loaded.
SUCCESS_USAGE_BILLING_READ.technicalDetail: Usage/billing read returned the caller's own usage (metered calls, balances) and billing (subscriptions, renewals, refunds, referral) from the existing ports.

RUN_NO_ARTIFACT_RECORDED.template: No {format} artifact was recorded for this run. The run record carries no {format} key, so Docs cannot link a file that was never recorded — this does not by itself prove the file was never generated.
RUN_NO_ARTIFACT_RECORDED.action: Re-run the screen, or use a regenerate path for this run once one exists for its family.

RUN_PDF_FAILED.template: PDF generation failed for this run{error}. The PDF leg failed while the other legs were attempted independently.
RUN_PDF_FAILED.action: Re-run the screen, or regenerate the PDF for this run once a regenerate path exists for its family.

RUN_XLSX_FAILED.template: XLSX generation failed for this run{error}. The XLSX leg failed while the other legs were attempted independently.
RUN_XLSX_FAILED.action: Re-run the screen, or regenerate the XLSX for this run once a regenerate path exists for its family.

RUN_CSV_FAILED.template: CSV generation failed for this run{error}. The CSV leg failed while the other legs were attempted independently.
RUN_CSV_FAILED.action: Re-run the screen, or regenerate the CSV for this run once a regenerate path exists for its family.

RUN_EMPTY_RESULT.template: This run completed with no results: the analysis ran, but nothing passed its gates, so there was no result set to report on.
RUN_EMPTY_RESULT.action: Widen the filters (universe, DTE window, or fit gates) and re-run, or inspect the stage trace for which gate excluded everything.

RUN_PARTIAL_COVERAGE.template: This run has partial coverage: it evaluated only part of the requested universe. The result set covers the evaluated subset, not the full request.
RUN_PARTIAL_COVERAGE.action: Check the stage trace for the failed or truncated underlyings, then re-run for the missing subset.

RUN_CAPTURE_MISSING.template: No stored data capture was recorded for this run{capture}. Analysis reads stored captures only; without one, the analysis stage cannot be evidenced.
RUN_CAPTURE_MISSING.action: Re-run the screen so feed/gather captures are recorded before analysis.

RUN_CONNECTOR_UNAVAILABLE.template: A connector was unavailable for enriching data during this run{connector}. The stage that needed it could not complete its enrichment.
RUN_CONNECTOR_UNAVAILABLE.action: Check the connector's availability and re-run; the stage trace names the connector and capability.

RUN_PROVIDER_FETCH_FAILED.template: A provider data fetch failed during this run{provider}. The stage that needed that data could not complete.
RUN_PROVIDER_FETCH_FAILED.action: Check the provider's availability and re-run; the stage trace names the provider.

RUN_FIT_GATE_ALL_REJECTED.template: The fit gate rejected every candidate for this run: candidates were evaluated, but none met the composite score, probability-of-profit, freshness, or confidence thresholds in force.
RUN_FIT_GATE_ALL_REJECTED.action: Loosen the fit gates or widen the universe/DTE window and re-run.

RUN_DTE_EXCLUDED_ALL.template: The DTE window excluded every contract for this run: no contract in the fetched chain fell inside the requested days-to-expiry window.
RUN_DTE_EXCLUDED_ALL.action: Widen the DTE window and re-run.

RUN_DUPLICATE_SUPPRESSED.template: This run was suppressed as a duplicate: an equivalent run for the same slot was already recorded, so this attempt recorded no new artifacts.
RUN_DUPLICATE_SUPPRESSED.action: Find the original run for the same slot; do not re-run for the same slot.

RUN_SERVICE_USER_NOT_PROVISIONED.template: The service user was not provisioned for this platform tier, so the scheduled tick that would have run this job was skipped before any stage ran.
RUN_SERVICE_USER_NOT_PROVISIONED.action: Provision the service user for the platform tier, then trigger the run again.

RUN_QUEUE_DROPPED.template: A queue message for this run was dropped without retry: the queue path that would have delivered it has no consumer, or the message was refused under its owner identity.
RUN_QUEUE_DROPPED.action: Trigger the run directly (Trigger-Now) and check the queue consumer wiring.

RUN_BRIDGE_SERVE_SKIPPED.template: The async-job bridge serve stage was skipped for this run because no PDF key was available (or the PDF leg had failed), so no serve record was written and no delivery was planned.
RUN_BRIDGE_SERVE_SKIPPED.action: Fix the PDF leg first, then re-run; serve cannot deliver a report with no PDF key.

RUN_STAGE_FAILED.template: The {stage} stage failed for this run{error}. Later stages were not planned after this failure.
RUN_STAGE_FAILED.action: Check the stage trace for the failing stage's error, then resume from the last completed stage or re-run.

RUN_NEVER_ATTEMPTED.template: The {format} leg was never attempted for this run: it is not part of this run type's path, so its absence is by construction, not a failure.
RUN_NEVER_ATTEMPTED.action: No action: this run type does not produce this format.

RUN_LEGACY_UNKNOWN.template: This field predates provenance/lineage recording for this run's store ({store}), so its value is unknown — it was not recorded, and it is not guessed here.
RUN_LEGACY_UNKNOWN.action: No action: newer runs for the same family record this field.
